snippet.title: Magical Girl Opal - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Hikari Saitou was just a normal student,until one day, she was transformed into Magical Girl Opal! As a magical girl, it is her duty to fight the evil organization called Cynthia, and to protect Earth from being conquered.
